thread:
maria: heads up — customer 'bluebox' opened a ticket: sudden p99 jump on /v1/chat endpoint after last infra push. p95 also up ~30%. Noticed increased time in attention kernels. Anyone digging?
kevin: on it. I saw a spike in kernel compile times around the deploy window. suspect the new SDPA compile flag we flipped yesterday.
sasha: can you paste the trace?
kevin: paste: ```
2026-03-16T22:03:12Z model=redwood-7b runtime=prod kernel=sdpa compile_flag=enable_sdp_v2 latency_p99_ms=612
2026-03-16T22:03:13Z model=redwood-7b runtime=prod kernel=flashattn compile_flag=enable_sdp_v2 latency_p99_ms=160
```
kevin: looks like SDPA paths are slower for some batch/seq combos. flash path much faster here.
ryan: that's consistent with telemetry — seq len spike to ~1024 for that tenant. sdpa heuristics misfired and used a fallback kernel with bad perf.
anita: we should throttle the flag. Can we back out the compileflag at runtime without full rollback?
kevin: yes, we have a runtime toggle. ops command: ```/ops toggle-compileflag --name sdp_v2 --set off --scope pool=prod-chat```
kevin: I executed on a small canary pool (chat-canary-1) and p99 dropped from ~620ms -> ~170ms for the repro prompts.
maria: nice. What's the safety risk? any correctness concerns?
kevin: no model outputs changed; it's purely kernel selection. SDPA was supposed to speed up some patterns but the new heuristic misclassified long-prefix workloads.
sasha: I'll open a hotfix PR to adjust the heuristic thresholds and add a seq_len histogram gating check.
ryan: short-term mitigation proposal: 1) toggle sdp_v2 off for prod-chat pool (kevin did canary) 2) pin flashattn for models with avg seq_len>512 3) create an autoswitch backoff when p95/p99 exceed thresholds
anita: agreed. Also add an alert rule so next time the deploy flips compileflag we'll get immediate paging if kernel selection diverges from baseline.
deploy-bot: deploy event detected: infra/2026-03-16T21:58 by ops-ci. compileflag sdp_v2=true rolled to 100% of prod-chat pool.
support-bot: ticket #4857 updated: customer notified that we're investigating latency and have a mitigation in canary.
maria: kevin — can you run a repro script and paste minimal steps so support can tell customer what to run if they see it?
kevin: repro steps: ```
1) set model=redwood-7b, batch=8, seq=1024, prompt=long prefix (~800 tokens)
2) call /v1/chat with streaming disabled to measure end-to-end
3) observe per-token kernel time in runtime logs: attention_kernel_time_ms
```
kevin: command to flip back for prod (after approvals): ```/ops toggle-compileflag --name sdp_v2 --set off --scope pool=prod-chat --audit-note "hotfix latency regression 2026-03-16"```
sasha: I'll land the heuristic PR and add unit tests that simulate long-prefix patterns + histogram gating.
ryan: postmortem owner? maria volunteer?
maria: I'll own the postmortem. action items: rollback compileflag (done after this thread), heuristic PR, add alerting, add canary perf test for every compileflag change, notify customers.
anita: I'll update runbook with the exact /ops commands and a checklist for kernel toggles.
support-bot: ticket #4857 comment: "We've applied a temporary mitigation and are rolling out a fix. We'll follow up with the postmortem."
maria: thanks everyone. I'll ping customer when canary looks stable (expected in ~20m). :thumbsup:
